stages.title: Database Meltdown Simulation
stages.description: The production database is under extreme load. Make split-second decisions to stabilize the system before the 45-second timer runs out.
stages.goalDescription: Complete all 4 steps while keeping system stability above 0%.

steps.label: Diagnostics
steps.description: CPU usage is at 99% and queries are timing out. What is your first move?

choices.label: Enable Read Replicas
choices.feedback: Good choice! Load is balancing out.

steps.label: Mitigation
steps.description: We need to shed load immediately. Which traffic do we drop?

choices.label: Drop API Traffic
choices.feedback: Partner integrations failing, but core breathes.

choices.label: Do Nothing
choices.feedback: Load continues to spike! Memory running out...

steps.label: Optimization
steps.description: Apply a permanent fix now that the bleeding is stopped.

choices.label: Add Missing Indexes
choices.feedback: Queries are blazing fast! CPU load dropped.

choices.label: Scale Vertically
choices.feedback: Scaling required downtime. System went offline.

steps.label: Recovery
steps.description: Manage the fallout and restore full capacity.

choices.label: Hide The Issue
choices.feedback: Twitter found out first. PR nightmare!

stages.title: Robot Delivery Mission
stages.description: Program the delivery bot to navigate the grid and reach the goal. Build a command sequence, then execute it. If you hit a wall or obstacle, the simulation fails.
stages.goalDescription: Navigate from top-left to bottom-right, avoiding obstacles.

stages.title: Package Delivery Challenge
stages.description: Navigate through a tight corridor and deliver the package. Use the 'deliver' command at the goal.
stages.goalDescription: Reach the delivery point at (3, 3) and execute 'deliver'.
